title: _meta.json - the run status card
description: Written by src/run/run_matsim.py when a run LAUNCHES and updated automatically at every transition: completed on rc=0, failed on rc!=0, aborted on interrupt or when a later harness invocation finds the recorded pid gone. It exists so runs can be observed, and considered or disregarded, without opening a log: status + the identifying parameters + started/ended. It is NOT a result and NOT the result gate - `_run.json` (written only on success) remains what makes a run a result; a directory whose meta says anything but completed is dead, and the harness renames it aborted_<name> so the name says so too. A dead run MUST also say WHY: `cause` is required on failed and aborted, read from the run's own matsim.log by src/run/run_failure.py rather than remembered by whoever was watching.

status.description: running: launched, harness alive. completed: rc=0. failed: the JVM exited non-zero. aborted: interrupted, killed, or found dead by reconciliation.

sample_pct.description: fraction x 100, so a person scanning results/ never has to convert.

inputs_sha256.description: sha256 of the day's population file the run sampled from (DECISIONS.md 9.127): part of the run's identity, so a rebuilt demand under the same parameters is a different run and cannot resume an earlier one; null when the file was absent.

rc.description: Process return code; null while running and for runs killed before one existed.

pid.description: The harness pid, so reconciliation can tell a live concurrent run from a dead one.

note.description: Free-text provenance, e.g. for metadata backfilled onto runs that predate this contract.

warm_started_from.description: Present only on a warm-started run (issue #75): the dead parent run and the plans checkpoint iteration this run continued from.

cause.description: Why this run died, in one line. REQUIRED on failed and aborted. Measured, never composed: normally the terminating exception MATSim printed, otherwise a statement about what the log does NOT contain. Never an attribution or a guess.

cause_detail.description: The evidence behind `cause`: the exception class, its message, its Caused by chain, and the matsim.log line it was read from. Absent when the log carried nothing to quote.

allOf.$comment: A dead run that cannot say why it died is a directory nobody can rule out - the defect this closes (three 25 August probe failures reached the next session with status failed, rc 1 and no reason).
